name: Christian Hedonism
overview: Christian Hedonism teaches that true joy and pleasure are found in a deep, abiding relationship with God. Scripture reveals that delighting in the Lord leads to the fulfillment of the desires of the heart (Psalms 37:4) and that in His presence there is fullness of joy and eternal pleasures (Psalms 16:11). The kingdom of heaven is likened to a treasure worth sacrificing all else to obtain (Matthew 13:44), and Christ promises that His joy will remain and be made full within believers (John 15:11). This joy is rooted in valuing the knowledge of Christ above all things (Philippians 3:8) and trusting that God rewards those who diligently seek Him in faith (Hebrews 11:6).
